basic_profile.bio: Tim is a 34-year-old software engineer living in Austin, Texas. He has a passion for technology and open-source projects, spending his free time contributing to MarlinFirmware and exploring advancements in computer vision algorithms. Tim is an avid gamer, particularly enjoying retro gaming on platforms like RetroPie and TF2 on PS3. He is a die-hard San Antonio Spurs fan, often engaging in discussions about their games and strategies. Tim's typical online hours are during the evenings and weekends, as he balances a demanding job with his hobbies. He is currently single, enjoying the flexibility it brings to focus on his interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Tim holds a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and has over a decade of experience in software development. He is self-taught in several programming languages and has a strong understanding of embedded systems, acquired through both professional work and personal projects. Tim frequently reads research papers and online forums to stay updated on the latest trends in technology.
